description: Local business search. Send what and where in one query, such as coffee roasters in Portland OR; returns up to 20 Google Maps business listings with name, address, coordinates, category, rating and review count, phone and website. Use to find or compare local businesses. Business listings only, not for finding people. Typical response about 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, lower case, such as us or gb.

language.description: Optional language code, lower case, such as en or pt-br.

query.description: What and where in one string, such as dentist in Austin TX.

name: quantagentshop_places_search
title: Places search
